status: declared by the pull request that closes #460 before any score was computed; nothing here is tuned on a scored day; the choices below are the pull request's, listed there for Eleonora's review

target.label: an onset at the threshold (pressure.onsets: a day above it with no such day on the five panel days before it) on any of the next five panel days; the first of the five is the day a one-day-ahead forecast scores
target.fit: the direct pairs at horizon 1 (as-of design at the decision instant, target row t); the label of a pair is read off training rows t to t + 4; a pair whose window reaches past the last training row trains nothing (ml._window_onset_labels raises LookAheadError for it)
target.one_probability_per_decision_day: the fit gives one probability per decision day d, P(an onset in d+1 .. d+5)
target.day_level_mapping: the horizon-h file the judge reads holds, for target day D, the window probability made at the decision day h business days before D, so the five files give each decision day's probability to each of the five days it covers; the judge's maximum over h of the horizon-h forecast of day t+h is then exactly the window probability of day t (tiers.week_ahead.combine = max), and a day D is flagged at lead h when the window probability made h days earlier reached the cut-off

recalibration: pressure.recalibrated with the outcome 'a pressure day (spread above the threshold) on any of the next five panel days' (the judge's tier 5 event), fitted out of fold on earlier windows that had ended by the refit's training end; the raw fits are kept as an ablation
cutoffs: chosen by the judge's cutoff_rule from each refit's training window alone (pressure_judge.json); none is declared here

features.note: each learner reads the inputs it was published or judged with (scripts/pressure_two_part.py FEATURES; repo_model.hierarchical_logistic.features_at_horizon(1)); the settlement columns are public one business day ahead, so they describe the window's first day only
